items.title: Oracle Notice to Weigh on Data Center Debt, Morgan Stanley Says
items.summary: Oracle Corp.’s force majeure notice to the developer of a massive New Mexico data center is putting loan and lease documents under fresh scrutiny and adding to the challenges facing companies looking to tap debt markets to finance the AI buildout, according to Morgan Stanley.
